source:
flowchart LR
    commit[Commit] --> lint[Lint]
    commit --> unit[Unit tests]
    commit --> build[Build image]
    lint --> gate{Checks pass?}
    unit --> gate
    build --> scan[Security scan]
    scan --> gate
    gate -->|no| notify[Notify author]
    gate -->|yes| staging[Deploy to staging]
    staging --> smoke[Smoke tests]
    staging --> perf[Load tests]
    smoke --> approve{Approved?}
    perf --> approve
    approve -->|no| rollback[Roll back staging]
    approve -->|yes| canary[Canary release]
    canary --> metrics[(Metrics store)]
    metrics --> healthy{Healthy?}
    healthy -->|yes| prod[Full rollout]
    healthy -->|no| rollback
    rollback --> notify
    prod --> done([Done])
